memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine follow‑up of glaucoma, generalised anxiety disorder and type 2 diabetes.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports stable vision, occasional worry, and no polyuria or polydipsia.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/82 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.58 m, BMI 27.2 (obese). Intraocular pressure 22 mmHg OU, visual fields full, optic discs cupped 0.6. Chest clear, no edema.
IMPRESSION: Glaucoma uncontrolled (IOP >21). Anxiety mild, GAD‑7 score 6. Diabetes suboptimal, HbA1c 7.8%, fasting glucose 156 mg/dL, LDL 130 mg/dL, triglycerides 180 mg/dL, HDL 38 mg/dL. TSH 2.1 mIU/L, Hb 13.2 g/dL.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue timolol 0.5% eye drops BD, latanoprost 0.005% eye drops HS, escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, metformin 500 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD before breakfast, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD. Advise low‑salt diet, 150 min brisk walk weekly. Return if eye pain, sudden vision loss, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient feels well, no new visual symptoms, anxiety unchanged.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/84 mmHg, weight 69 kg, BMI 27.6 (obese). IOP 21 mmHg OU. No pedal edema.
IMPRESSION: IOP borderline, continue glaucoma meds. Diabetes: HbA1c 7.8% unchanged, fasting glucose 156 mg/dL, LDL 130, triglycerides 180, HDL 38. Anxiety GAD‑7 6.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase metformin to 850 mg BD. Keep glimepiride 1 mg OD. Reinforce diet and activity. Return if eye pain, vision change, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling more anxious lately, trouble sleeping and my mind races. Can we increase my buspirone?

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: increased anxiety symptoms.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports worsening worry, insomnia, restlessness over past 4 weeks.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/80 mmHg, weight 68.5 kg, BMI 27.4 (obese). IOP 20 mmHg OU.
IMPRESSION: Generalised anxiety disorder exacerbated, GAD‑7 now 12. Diabetes stable, HbA1c 7.8% (last). Glaucoma controlled.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase buspirone to 10 mg BD. Offer influenza vaccine (given today). Continue other meds. Advise sleep hygiene, limit caffeine. Return if panic attacks, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

Reason for visit: review of diabetes labs and eye exam.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient denies visual blurring, reports occasional fatigue.
EXAMINATION: BP 132/84 mmHg, weight 69 kg, BMI 27.6 (obese). IOP 20 mmHg OU.
IMPRESSION: Diabetes improving, HbA1c 7.2% down from 7.8%, microalbuminuria present. Glaucoma stable. Anxiety controlled on buspirone 10 mg BD, GAD‑7 5.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase metformin to 1000 mg BD. Keep glimepiride 1 mg OD. Continue sitagliptin, empagliflozin. Reinforce low‑sodium diet, weight loss goal 5 kg. Return if eye pain, vision loss, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.
